name: prov_query
description: Answer provenance questions - lineage, downstream impact, what happened when - from the traces through dftracer-utils' TraceViewer, with evidence: the question becomes a plan of concrete steps, each a TraceViewer query, the result is computed, and the write-up cites the steps. Load for the analysis pipeline's query stage and for any question in the Query view of a run, live run or dataset.

history.why: answer_publish: evidence-backed answer cards (query plan, evidence, answer), checked against the traces

No model in an answer: evidence_answer runs a plan of TraceViewer queries (resolved entities, time frames, lineage hops) and computes the result with its trail; evidence_synthesis attaches the agent's write-up, checked (citations [Sk], numbers from the result). answer_publish (agent-written answers) removed; query_summary/entities/lineage read through TraceViewer.
The four aspects of provenance: evidence_answer documents their operations and the skill routes each aspect's questions.
